# n8n_data_table (Resource)

n8n data table resource. Note: columns cannot be changed after creation; to change columns, delete and recreate the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Data table name

### Optional

- `columns` (Block List) Column definitions for the data table. Cannot be changed after creation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--columns))
- `project_id` (String) Project ID the data table belongs to

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the data table was created
- `id` (String) Data table identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the data table was last updated

<a id="nestedblock--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Required:

- `name` (String) Column name
- `type` (String) Column data type
